answer: To resist Sybil attacks, an agent economy deploys game-theoretic multi-agent auditing with stake slashing and topological cut verifications across interaction graphs. An adversary attempting to harvest value by clustering fake identities inside a synthetic agent grove discovers that isolated cuts trigger random cross-audits. Dishonest collusion leads to slashed deposits, imposing a superlinear attacker cost that turns Sybil infiltration from a profitable scheme into a ruinous fable, cracking the attacker's capital like a fragile walnut shell.
